blocks.text: Netflix announced Monday that it will produce the second and third seasons of “The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call” simultaneously, with a member of Lovelyz newly joining the series’ central trio. According to the streamer, Jung will take over the role of Cheon Jang-mi, a veteran nurse who forms the show’s central trio alongside brilliant surgeon Baek Gang-hyeok (Ju Ji-hoon) and his protege Yang Jae-won (Choo Young-woo). Both Ju and Choo are set to reprise their roles. READ: Ju Ji-hoon seeks catharsis in ‘The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call’ The character was previously portrayed by actor Ahn Ha-young.
